purpose: camera-ready Table 2 organizer-hosted evaluation of the final method

reported_precision.structural: Mean, median, and minimum MS-SSIM and median LPIPS are retained at the available analysis precision; the remaining values are at camera-ready table precision.
reported_precision.derived_views: OAC, SC, and RSC aggregates are retained at camera-ready table precision.
reported_precision.competition_formula_estimate: Retained at the available aggregate-analysis precision.

derived_view_note: OAC, SC, and RSC are organizer-defined views derived from the structural B-scan, not independently calibrated ground truth.

reproduction.credentials: A fresh run requires SYNTHOCT_API_KEY and access to the external organizer service.
reproduction.outputs: The runner regenerates request state, raw and grayscale renders, feature maps, detail.csv, and summary.json below outputs/; outputs/ is ignored by Git.
reproduction.historical_evidence_limit: Historical per-request state, request IDs, and raw hosted outputs were not retained in the public repository. A rerun creates new request IDs, so this compact camera-ready aggregate cannot authenticate a historical request ledger.
